title: psilolepus pedunculatus
intro: Psilolepus pedunculatus, commonly known as the "Sapucaia" or "Cipó-preto", is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. It is a type of legume that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in the treatment of conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Psilolepus pedunculatus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, antiseptic, and expectorant effects.
